latest.title: Minat Mahasiswa Universitas Muhammadiyah Sumatera Utara terhadap Pengeluaran Menggunakan QRIS dan Tunai di Café Celesco Mukhtar Basri Medan
latest.abstract: Tujuan dari penelitian ini adalah untuk mengetahui minat mahasiswa Universitas Muhammadiyah Sumatera Utara terhadap penggunaan QRIS dan pembayaran tunai serta hubungannya dengan cara mereka membelanjakan uang di Café Celesco Mukhtar Basri Medan. Dalam penelitian ini, metode kualitatif deskriptif diterapkan pada subjek penelitian, yaitu mahasiswa yang pernah bertransaksi di kafe tersebut. Data dikumpulkan melalui observasi langsung, dan informan dipilih melalui teknik purposive sampling. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa mahasiswa memiliki minat yang sama terhadap QRIS dan tunai, dan keduanya digunakan bersama dalam transaksi sehari-hari. Sejalan dengan Technology Acceptance Model, QRIS praktis, cepat, mudah digunakan, dan memudahkan pencatatan biaya melalui riwayat transaksi. Pembayaran tunai tetap menjadi pilihan utama siswa karena kemudahan, kebiasaan, kenyamanan, dan ketersediaan saldo digital dan uang tunai. Ini juga menjadi alternatif ketika saldo digital tidak cukup atau jaringan terganggu. Sementara QRIS dapat mengurangi kesadaran tentang jumlah uang yang dibelanjakan, terutama untuk transaksi kecil, tunai memberikan gambaran yang lebih langsung tentang pengeluaran. Namun, metode pembayaran tidak secara langsung mempengaruhi jumlah yang dihabiskan. Pengeluaran sehari-hari lebih bergantung pada kebiasaan dan kemampuan mengelola keuangan, seperti membuat anggaran, mengendalikan diri, dan memeriksa transaksi.

latest.title: THE MEDIATING ROLE OF BRAND IMAGE IN THE EFFECTS OF PRICE PERCEPTION AND PROMOTION ON REPURCHASE INTENTION(A Study of Fore Coffee Customers in Denpasar City)
authors: Ni Luh Ayu Yuliantari, Ni Nyoman Kerti Yasa, Ni Wayan Ekawati, Gede Bayu Rahanatha
latest.abstract: Fore Coffee continues to expand its number of outlets, but its brand strength in encouraging repeat purchases remains weaker than that of its main competitors, despite its products being among the most expensive compared to those offered by locally established coffee chains. This study aims to analyze the effects of price perception and promotion on repurchase intention, as well as the mediating role of brand image in these relationships. The study was conducted among Fore Coffee customers in Denpasar City, involving a sample of 150 respondents selected through judgment sampling. Data were collected using a five-point Likert scale questionnaire and analyzed using Partial Least Squares Structural Equation Modeling (PLS-SEM) with SmartPLS 4. The results show that price perception and promotion have positive and significant effects on both brand image and repurchase intention, while brand image has a positive and significant effect on repurchase intention. Brand image partially mediates the effects of price perception and promotion on repurchase intention, with mediation proportions of 39.47 percent for the price perception path and 52.73 percent for the promotion path. Brand image is the strongest predictor of repurchase intention, whereas the direct effect of promotion is the weakest. These findings indicate that price perception operates more strongly through a direct effect, while promotion works more extensively through brand image formation. Fore Coffee management is advised to prioritize strengthening the brand's distinctive identity and designing promotional activities as a means of building brand image, rather than using them solely as short-term transactional incentives.

latest.title: Consumer decision in online processed-food purchase: income, price, and digital quality perception
latest.venue: Journal of Agribusiness in Developing and Emerging Economies
latest.abstract: Purpose This study analyzes the association of consumer income with online processed-food demand through digital quality perception and perceived price on digital food platforms in Makassar, Indonesia. Design/methodology/approach This study uses a cross-sectional online survey of 162 female household food decision-makers. Data were analyzed using covariance-based structural equation modeling in International Business Machines Statistical Package for the Social Sciences Analysis of Moment Structures, with bias-corrected bootstrapping used to assess the indirect association. Findings Consumer income was positively associated with perceived price, but not with digital quality perception or online processed-food demand. Digital quality perception was positively associated with perceived price and online processed-food demand, whereas perceived price was not directly associated with demand. The indirect association was positive but not statistically significant. The model explained 56% of the variance in online processed-food demand. Research limitations/implications The single-city purposive sample and cross-sectional design limit causal interpretation and statistical generalizability. Future studies should use longitudinal, multisource, or platform-based transaction data. Social implications Reliable digital product information can support informed consumer choice and strengthen trust in developing-economy e-commerce. Originality/value This study provides developing-market evidence that platform-based quality cues are the closest correlates of online processed-food demand, while price plays a limited direct role.

latest.title: Pengaruh Content Marketing dan ElePengaruh Content Marketing dan Electronic Word of Mouth (E-WOM) terhadap Repeat Order Produk Skincare di TikTok Shopctronic Word of Mouth (E-WOM) terhadap Repeat Order Produk Skincare di TikTok Shop
latest.abstract: This study examines the effect of Content Marketing and Electronic Word of Mouth (E-WOM) on repeat orders of skincare products on TikTok Shop. A quantitative associative approach was applied. Data were collected through an online questionnaire using a five-point Likert scale from 26 respondents selected through purposive sampling. The data were analyzed using descriptive statistics and multiple linear regression, including t-test, F-test, and the coefficient of determination. The reported results show that Content Marketing has a positive but statistically insignificant partial effect on Repeat Order (p = 0.252). In contrast, E-WOM has a positive and significant partial effect (p = 0.008). Simultaneously, Content Marketing and E-WOM significantly affect Repeat Order (F-test significance = 0.000088). The coefficient of determination is 0.556, indicating that the two independent variables explain 55.6% of the variation in Repeat Order. The findings suggest that consumer reviews and shared experiences are important considerations in repeat purchasing, while content marketing should be supported by product quality and a satisfactory consumer experience.

latest.title: Transformasi Perilaku Konsumtif Menjadi Perilaku Produktif melalui Kebiasaan Menabung Saham
latest.abstract: Perkembangan teknologi finansial dan ekosistem belanja daring (e-commerce) telah mempercepat budaya konsumtif di kalangan masyarakat usia produktif, khususnya Generasi Milenial dan Generasi Z. Fenomena belanja impulsif akibat gaya hidup hedonis dan tekanan sosial di media digital mengancam ketahanan keuangan mereka dalam jangka panjang. Penelitian ini bertujuan menganalisis bagaimana kebiasaan menabung saham di pasar modal dapat mengubah perilaku konsumtif menjadi perilaku produktif. Penelitian ini menggunakan metode kualitatif melalui tinjauan pustaka sistematis (systematic literature review) terhadap 15 artikel jurnal terakreditasi nasional dan internasional yang terbit pada tahun 2024 hingga 2026. Hasil kajian menunjukkan bahwa kebiasaan menabung saham berfungsi sebagai sarana intervensi perilaku yang menggeser tujuan penggunaan uang, dari sekadar memuaskan keinginan sesaat menjadi upaya mengumpulkan aset produktif. Proses perubahan ini terjadi melalui empat mekanisme utama, yaitu menata ulang pola pikir penganggaran (mental accounting), menerapkan prinsip membayar diri sendiri terlebih dahulu (pay yourself first), mengganti kesenangan belanja sesaat dengan kepuasan melihat pertumbuhan aset, serta memanfaatkan aplikasi keuangan sebagai pengunci komitmen. Keberhasilan perubahan perilaku ini didukung oleh empat faktor penentu, yakni pemahaman keuangan yang praktis, pengendalian diri dari rasa takut tertinggal tren (FoMO), konsistensi mengelola keuangan, serta dukungan lingkungan sosial dan lembaga edukasi. Kebiasaan menyisihkan dana secara rutin ke instrumen saham terbukti mampu menekan belanja impulsif sekaligus membangun kemandirian ekonomi.

latest.title: EKSPLORASI PERILAKU EKONOMI SISWA DALAM PENGGUNAAN E-WALLET SEBAGAI BENTUK LITERASI KEUANGAN DIGITAL DI SMA NEGERI 17 MEDAN
latest.abstract: This study aims to explore students' economic behavior in using e-wallets as a form of digital financial literacy at SMA Negeri 17 Medan. This study employed a qualitative method with an exploratory approach. The research informants consisted of 15 students as primary informants and 2 teachers as supporting informants. Data were collected through semi-structured interviews, observation, and documentation. Data analysis used the Miles and Huberman interactive model, consisting of data collection, data reduction, data display, and conclusion drawing and verification. Data validity was established through source and technique triangulation.The results showed that students' use of e-wallets was influenced by personal needs, convenience and practicality of transactions, social environment, technological development, as well as promotions and cashback. E-wallets were used for various purposes, including purchasing food and beverages, online shopping, internet quota payments, money transfers, transportation, and other needs. Students' economic behavior in managing their finances varied. Some students were able to set spending limits, monitor their balance, record transactions, save money, and prioritize their needs, while others had less control over their spending and were easily influenced by wants and promotional offers. The study also revealed a gap between students' ability to operate e-wallet features and their ability to manage finances wisely. Therefore, e-wallet use can become part of digital financial literacy when accompanied by the ability to manage, control, and evaluate financial use

latest.title: Price Perception and Promotional Effectiveness in Airport Food & Beverage Consumption: An Exploratory Survey with Implications for Rajiv Gandhi International Airport, Hyderabad
latest.abstract: Airport food and beverage (F&B) outlets operate in a distinctive retail environment in which passengers balance convenience, time constraints and reference prices shaped by alternatives outside the terminal. This study examines perceived airport F&B prices, reported price-related purchase deterrence, promotional visibility and preferred purchase triggers, drawing on an online questionnaire completed by 86 respondents and a qualitative secondary-research review undertaken as part of a Summer Internship Project (SIP). The secondary review covered airport commercial environments and F&B practices at Rajiv Gandhi International Airport (RGIA), Delhi, Mumbai and Bengaluru. In the survey, 60.0% of valid respondents rated airport F&B prices in the two highest categories on a five-point scale, and 91.8% reported that high prices had deterred a purchase at least sometimes. Promotional visibility was relatively high (87.1% noticed promotions always, often or sometimes), while 6.0% reported being frequently influenced by promotions. Combo offers were selected by 67.1% as an activity that could encourage trial, and 72.6% identified lower prices as a change that would encourage purchase. Overall experience averaged 3.07 (SD = 0.80; n = 84). The findings point to perceived value and offer design as important issues for further investigation. The survey questions refer to airport F&B generally rather than documenting transactions at RGIA specifically; therefore, the findings are interpreted as exploratory evidence with implications for RGIA, not as representative estimates of its passengers. The sample is non-probability-based and self-reported.

latest.title: PENGARUH CONTENT MARKETING DAN PERSEPSI HARGA TERHADAP KEPUTUSAN PEMBELIAN KONSUMEN DI OLLSHOPBYDINDA
latest.abstract: The rapid growth of digital business has encouraged business owners to implement effective marketing strategies to enhance consumers' purchasing decisions. Content Marketing and price perception are considered important factors that may influence consumers' purchasing decisions. This study aims to analyze the effects of Content Marketing and price perception, both simultaneously and partially, on consumers' purchasing decisions at Ollshopbydinda. This research employed a quantitative method with a causal approach. The sampling technique used was purposive sampling, resulting in a total of 100 respondents. Data were collected through questionnaires and analyzed using multiple linear regression with the assistance of SPSS version 26. The results indicate that Content Marketing and price perception simultaneously have a significant effect on consumers' purchasing decisions. Partially, Content Marketing has a positive and significant effect on consumers' purchasing decisions. Likewise, price perception also has a positive and significant effect on consumers' purchasing decisions

latest.title: Pengaruh Mikrotransaksi Game Online terhadap Pengelolaan Keuangan Mahasiswa (Survei pada Mahasiswa Jurusan Akuntansi Fakultas Ekonomi dan Bisnis Universitas Halu Oleo)
latest.venue: Jurnal Semesta Ilmu Manajemen dan Ekonomi
latest.abstract: Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk mengetahui pengaruh mikrotransaksi game online terhadap pengelolaan keuangan mahasiswa Jurusan Akuntansi Fakultas Ekonomi dan Bisnis Universitas Halu Oleo. Populasi dalam penelitian ini adalah mahasiswa Jurusan Akuntansi Fakultas Ekonomi dan Bisnis Universitas Halu Oleo angkatan 2022–2025. Teknik pengambilan sampel menggunakan metode purposive sampling, sehingga diperoleh 90 responden. Jenis data yang digunakan adalah data kuantitatif dengan sumber data primer yang diperoleh melalui penyebaran kuesioner. Metode analisis data menggunakan regresi linear sederhana dengan bantuan software IBM SPSS versi 31. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa mikrotransaksi game online berpengaruh negatif terhadap pengelolaan keuangan mahasiswa. Hal ini menunjukkan bahwa semakin tinggi intensitas mahasiswa dalam melakukan mikrotransaksi, maka kemampuan mereka dalam mengelola keuangan cenderung menurun. Berdasarkan hasil penelitian dapat disimpulkan bahwa mikrotransaksi memiliki pengaruh negatif terhadap pengelolaan keuangan mahasiswa, sehingga mahasiswa disarankan untuk mampu meningkatkan pengendalian keuangan, khususnya dalam pengeluaran pada mikrotransaksi game online.

latest.title: Beyond Rational Choice: A Behavioral Game-Theoretic Frameworkfor Consumer Decision-Making
latest.venue: Journal of Asia Entrepreneurship and Sustainability
latest.abstract: Since Behavioral Economics explains decisions through bounded rationality and mental shortcuts, it is necessary to incorporate strategic interactions into such analyses. This study develops an integrated framework for analyzing irrational purchasing decisions, which includes elements of Behavioral Economics, non-cooperative Game Theory, econometric analysis, and an integrated model of consumer behavior, the Consumer Irrational Utility Model (CIUM). The study employs a quantitative survey of personal care products consumers in the FMCG market, modeling a consumer and a seller as two players in a 2 × 2 non-cooperative game. The game is analyzed using best-response strategies, followed by the derivation of a mixed-strategy Nash equilibrium. The results of the game-theoretic model are then tested using Linear Probability Model (LPM) and Weighted Least Squares (WLS) for estimation purposes. The results of the behavioral determinants, validated in the LPM and WLS estimations, are then incorporated into CIUM, which explains how irrational behavior by a consumer deviates from the utility-maximizing behavior of a rational human being. The study reveals that in the Indian FMCG market, consumers mainly adopt the Relative Decision Paradox strategy, whereas sellers mainly adopt the Strategized Pricing strategy. The study further reveals that the behavioral variables identified in the study have a significant impact on consumers' purchasing decisions. Also, results from the CIUM indicate that the economic utility of a product and the utility influenced by various behavioral factors in strategic interactions in the market jointly determine the overall utility of a product for a consumer.

latest.title: CONSUMER EVALUATIONS OF RESTAURANTS IN BOLU ON DIGITAL PLATFORMS: THE TRIPADVISOR CASE
latest.abstract: This study examines user reviews of restaurants in Bolu on Tripadvisor. The research uses a qualitative approach and employs descriptive content analysis as the analytical method. A total of 274 user reviews from 10 restaurants that provided meaningful content and were posted between January and December 2025 were analyzed. The findings indicate that most reviews were positive, with taste being the most frequently emphasized dimension. Analyses of food and beverage offerings confirm the meat-based nature of Bolu cuisine, while local dishes such as mantı, gözleme, and soups strongly reflect the region’s gastronomic identity on digital platforms. Additionally, staff and service quality, atmosphere and ambiance, cleanliness and hygiene, and price–value perception were identified as key themes shaping the user experience. Overall, the results support the influence of digital user evaluations on restaurant image and consumer preference decisions, and demonstrate that both product quality and service performance in gastronomic destinations are perceived and evaluated through online platforms.

latest.title: Peran Pemasaran Media Sosial dan Atribut Produk dalam Keputusan Pembelian Paket Wisata One Day Lampung
latest.abstract: This research is motivated by the importance of social media marketing and product attributes in influencing consumer purchase decisions on tour packages. This study aims to determine the influence of social media marketing on purchase decisions, the influence of product attributes on purchase decisions, and the influence of social media marketing and product attributes simultaneously on the purchase decision of One Day Lampung tour packages at CV Wondery Agita Wisata. This study uses a quantitative method. Data was collected through the distribution of questionnaires to 150 respondents who had purchased One Day Lampung tour packages and viewed CV Wondery Agita Wisata social media marketing content using purposive sampling techniques. Data analysis was carried out using validity tests, reliability tests, classical assumption tests, multiple linear regression analysis, t-tests, and F tests with the help of the Statistical Package for Social Science (SPSS) program, The results of the study showed that social media marketing had a significant influence on the purchase decision of tour packages. Product attributes also have a significant influence on purchasing decisions. In addition, social media marketing and product attributes simultaneously have a significant influence on the purchase decision of One Day Lampung tour packages at CV Wondery Agita Wisata.

latest.title: PENERAPAN MENTAL ACCOUNTING DALAM PENGELOLAAN BISNIS GYM (STUDI KASUS ESHADE FITNESS CENTER)
latest.abstract: This study aims to analyze the application of mental accounting in the financial management of a gym business that faces recurring, seasonal fluctuations in membership numbers. It explores how the business owner manages funds to navigate off-peak seasons. Employing a qualitative approach with a case study design, the research focuses on Eshade Fitness Center. Data were collected through semi-structured interviews with the owner-manager and analyzed via data reduction and conclusion drawing. The findings reveal that the owner-manager categorizes revenue from memberships, personal training services, and product sales into distinct types of funds: "entrusted funds" (held on behalf of others), "profit-sharing funds," and "trading funds." These funds are allocated to fixed operational costs, salaries, maintenance, and the owner’s profit, with varying rules for inter-fund borrowing; while funds allocated for salaries and fixed operational costs cannot be borrowed, the other categories may be accessed, provided they are repaid. The business undergoes regular evaluation. During peak periods, surplus revenue is set aside as a reserve for the off-peak season, whereas during quieter periods, a decline in revenue is viewed as expected, given the owner’s familiarity with the business’s seasonal calendar. The study concludes that the owner utilizes three components of mental accounting, a practice that helps cover expenses during off-peak periods without the need to incur debt.

latest.title: Pengaruh Ulasan Pelanggan Online dan Persepsi Harga terhadap Niat Beli Konsumen Sudut Kedai di Metland Transyogi
latest.abstract: A sharp increase in menu prices at Sudut Kedai, coupled with shifting customer engagement online, raises a fundamental question: do online reviews and price perception actually influence purchase intention? This study examines both factors among Sudut Kedai consumers in Metland Transyogi. Questionnaires were distributed to 120 respondents who had read online reviews of Sudut Kedai, selected through convenience sampling. Data analysis was conducted using Partial Least Squares-Structural Equation Modeling (PLS-SEM) with SmartPLS 3.0. Online customer reviews demonstrate a positive and significant effect on purchase intention (path coefficient 0.245; T-statistic 3.271; p 0.001), as does price perception (path coefficient 0.373; T-statistic 4.861; p 0.000), with an R-Square of 0.220. Credible and informative reviews build buyer trust; prices perceived as proportional to quality enhance purchase intention. Sudut Kedai needs to actively manage customer reviews and maintain fair pricing to strengthen purchase intention amid an increasingly competitive culinary market.

latest.title: The Influence Of Price Perception And Online Customer Reviews On Purcashing Decisions For House Of Smith Products On The Tiktok Application
latest.venue: Journal of Management Economic and Accounting
latest.abstract: This study aims to analyze the effect of price perception and online customer reviews on purchasing decisions for House of Smith products through the TikTok application. The study employed a quantitative method with descriptive and causal approaches. The population consisted of House of Smith consumers on TikTok, whose total number was unknown, while a sample of 100 respondents was selected using non-probability sampling with a purposive sampling technique based on the Lemeshow formula. Primary data were collected through an online questionnaire using a five-point Likert scale, transformed using the Method of Successive Interval (MSI), and analyzed by multiple linear regression with SPSS version 25. The results show that price perception and online customer reviews simultaneously have a significant effect on purchasing decisions, with an F-value of 34.359 and p < 0.001. Partially, price perception has a positive and significant effect, with a regression coefficient of 0.152, a t-value of 2.170, and p = 0.032. Online customer reviews also have a positive and significant effect, with a regression coefficient of 0.400, a t-value of 4.683, and p < 0.001. The R Square value of 0.415 indicates that both variables explain 41.5% of the variation in purchasing decisions, while the remaining 58.5% is explained by other factors outside the study. These findings indicate that online customer reviews exert a more dominant influence than price perception in encouraging purchasing decisions for House of Smith products on TikTok

latest.title: Pengaruh Kualitas Pelayanan, Persepsi Harga, dan Word of Mouth terhadap Loyalitas Pelanggan Lily Laundry Express
latest.venue: Indonesian Journal of Innovation Multidisipliner Research
latest.abstract: Kedekatan antarpesaing di sekitar kampus dan pondok pesantren memberi pelanggan banyak pilihan jasa laundry. Penelitian ini menganalisis hubungan kualitas pelayanan, persepsi harga, dan word of mouth dengan loyalitas pelanggan Lily Laundry Express di Kalibeber, Wonosobo. Penelitian menggunakan survei potong lintang terhadap 100 pelanggan yang dipilih melalui purposive sampling. Analisis mencakup 14 butir pernyataan berskala Likert lima tingkat, statistik deskriptif, uji validitas butir dan reliabilitas, serta regresi linier berganda dengan galat baku robust HC3. Kualitas pelayanan berhubungan positif dan signifikan dengan loyalitas pelanggan (B = 0,295, p = 0,0199). Persepsi harga (p = 0,7051) dan word of mouth (p = 0,0957) tidak menunjukkan hubungan parsial yang signifikan. Model signifikan secara keseluruhan, F(3, 96) = 8,363 dengan p < 0,001, dan menjelaskan 43,2% variasi skor loyalitas pelanggan. Temuan ini mendukung penetapan kualitas pelayanan sebagai prioritas dalam mempertahankan pelanggan, terutama melalui konsistensi hasil cucian, ketepatan waktu penyelesaian, dan ketanggapan karyawan. Implikasi praktis dari studi ini menegaskan bahwa manajemen perlu merancang standar operasional prosedur yang terukur guna menjaga kebersihan dan kerapian pakaian secara berkelanjutan. Selain itu, pelatihan rutin bagi staf operasional serta penyediaan saluran komunikasi keluhan yang responsif sangat diperlukan untuk mencegah perpindahan pelanggan ke penyedia jasa kompetitor. Studi lanjutan disarankan mengkaji variabel kepuasan dan kepercayaan pelanggan.

latest.title: When Halal Brand Trust Does Not Guarantee Brand Equity: Evidence from Hijab-Oriented Hair Care
latest.venue: International Journal of Humanity Advance Business & Sciences (IJHABS)
latest.abstract: Halal brand trust plays an important role in shaping consumer confidence, yet its contribution to customer-based brand equity remains inconclusive. This study examines the relationships among halal brand image, halal brand trust, and halal brand equity, emphasizing the mediating role of halal brand trust in Indonesia's hijab-oriented hair-care market. A quantitative approach employing a cross-sectional survey design and purposive sampling was specified, with data analyzed using partial least squares structural equation modeling (PLS-SEM). The analytical findings indicate that halal brand image is positively associated with both halal brand trust and halal brand equity. However, halal brand trust does not demonstrate a statistically significant relationship with halal brand equity, and its mediating effect is not supported. These findings suggest that favorable halal brand perceptions can strengthen consumer confidence without necessarily translating into additional brand value. The study highlights a distinction between trust formation and brand equity development, suggesting that confidence in halal compliance alone may be insufficient to create meaningful brand differentiation. The proposed framework contributes to halal branding research by examining the limitations of trust as a mechanism connecting halal brand image to brand equity within hijab-oriented personal care. From a managerial perspective, the analysis emphasizes the potential importance of complementing credible halal positioning with distinctive product benefits and consistent functional performance to strengthen customer-based brand equity.

latest.title: THE EFFECT OF SOCIAL MEDIA AND SERVICE QUALITY ON CUSTOMER LOYALTY AT BARBERSHOP ODE IN JAMBI CITY
latest.venue: Indonesian Journal of Social Sciences, Policy and Politics.
latest.abstract: This study aims to analyze the role of social media and service quality in shaping customer loyalty at Barbershop Ode in Jambi City. This study uses a descriptive qualitative approach through observation, documentation, and a literature review of seven relevant local journals. Documentation data indicate that the number of customers increased from 9,000 in 2021 to 10,800 in 2025, although a decline occurred in 2023. Meanwhile, Instagram followers increased from 379 to 691, while the engagement rate remained at approximately 1.5%. The percentage of repeat customers ranged from 35% to 45%, with approximately 80–100 regular customers remaining active each month.The findings indicate that social media plays an important role in increasing brand awareness, providing information, encouraging interaction, and maintaining relationships with customers. Furthermore, service quality, measured through five dimensions: tangibles, reliability, responsiveness, assurance, and empathy, contributes to creating positive customer experiences, satisfaction, and trust. These two aspects complement each other in building customer loyalty. Social media helps shape customer perceptions and expectations, while service quality determines the actual experiences customers receive when using the services. Positive experiences can encourage customers to revisit and recommend the barbershop to others.This study concludes that customer loyalty at Barbershop Ode can be strengthened through the integration of effective social media strategies and consistent improvements in service quality. Therefore, both aspects are essential in maintaining customer relationships, increasing repeat visits, and supporting the long-term sustainability of the business.

latest.title: THE ROLE OF PRODUCT QUALITY AND PROMOTION ON CONSUMER TRUST IN PRELOVED CLOTHING IN JAMBI
latest.venue: Indonesian Journal of Social Sciences, Policy and Politics.
latest.abstract: This study aims to analyze the role of product quality and promotional strategies in building consumer trust in preloved clothing purchases in Jambi City. This research employs a descriptive qualitative approach using observation and literature review. Observations focused on product characteristics, sorting and grading processes, information transparency, digital promotional activities on Instagram, TikTok, and WhatsApp, seller-consumer interactions, and social proof such as reviews and testimonials. The literature review examined seven verified national journal articles relevant to product quality, promotion, and consumer trust, complemented by three articles from the Indonesian Journal of Social Sciences, Policy and Politics (IJSSPP). Findings indicate that product quality is not only about physical condition but also consistency between actual product condition and information provided. Promotional strategy functions as uncertainty reduction. Transparent, informative, and testimonial-supported promotions strengthen trust, while excessive promotion without quality creates doubt. Consumer trust is formed through consistency between pre-transaction communication and post-transaction experience.

latest.title: Price, Promotion, and Consumer Reviews on Repurchase Intention through Customer Satisfaction among Marketplace Users
latest.abstract: This study aimed to analyze the effects of price, promotion, and consumer reviews on repurchase intention with customer satisfaction as a mediating variable among marketplace users. An explanatory quantitative approach was employed using Structural Equation Modeling–Partial Least Squares (SEM-PLS). Data were obtained through questionnaires from 152 university students in Probolinggo Regency who used marketplaces. The analysis showed that price, promotion, and consumer reviews had positive and significant effects on customer satisfaction. Customer satisfaction also had a positive and significant effect on repurchase intention. Directly, price, promotion, and consumer reviews had positive and significant effects on repurchase intention. The indirect-effect analysis showed that customer satisfaction mediated the relationships of price, promotion, and consumer reviews with repurchase intention. These findings indicate that fair pricing, relevant promotions, and credible consumer reviews can strengthen satisfaction and encourage repeat purchases in marketplaces

latest.title: Peran E-Review dalam Memediasi Influencer Marketing dan Price Diversity terhadap Purchase Decision Produk Fashion di Marketplace (Studi Kasus pada Remaja Putri di Kota Pontianak)
latest.venue: Jurnal Ekonomi Bisnis Manajemen dan Akuntansi
latest.abstract: This study aims to investigate the influence of e-reviews as a mediating variable between influencer marketing and price diversity on fashion product purchase decisions among young women in Pontianak City on marketplace platforms This study employs a quantitative method with an explanatory research approach. The sampling technique uses purposive sampling, with a sample size of 125 respondents. Data collection was conducted via a questionnaire and analyzed using SmartPLS 4. The results indicate that both influencer marketing and price diversity have a significant positive influence on e-reviews and purchasing decisions. In addition, e-reviews also have a significant positive effect on purchasing decisions. Furthermore, e-reviews were found to act as a partial mediator linking influencer marketing and price diversity to purchasing decisions. This study highlights the important role of integrated collaboration between influencer marketing, price diversity, and e-reviews in shaping purchasing decisions for fashion products on marketplaces

latest.title: The impact of tax compliance governance on the corporate financial performance during the COVID-19 crisis
latest.abstract: This study examines how tax compliance governance affects the financial performance of listed companies in Morocco during the challenging COVID-19 crisis period. Building on the recognition that tax compliance extends well beyond traditional control mechanisms and is shaped by broader institutional and behavioral factors (Alm, 2019), alongside evidence that responsible corporate practices can strengthen relationships with key stakeholders (Freeman et al., 2010), we approached the tax compliance seal as a governance mechanism with the potential to generate tangible financial benefits. Using panel data from 2013 to 2021, we conducted a linear regression analysis, completed with robustness tests to evaluate model specification and ensure estimate reliability. The results show a significant positive relationship between the tax compliance seal and firms’ financial performance, although its effects vary by performance indicator and time period. These results suggest that effective tax compliance governance can strengthen financial resilience and market capitalization during times of economic uncertainty.

latest.title: The Influence of Social Media Marketing and Brand Awareness on Purchase Decisions for Decoration Services at Catasa.id In South Tangerang
latest.abstract: This study aims to determine the effect of Social Media Marketing and Brand Awareness on purchase decisions for decoration services through Instagram @Catasa.id, both partially and simultaneously. The research used a quantitative associative approach. Data were collected through questionnaires from 106 respondents who knew or had interacted with @Catasa.id. The data were analyzed using validity and reliability tests, classical assumption tests, simple and multiple linear regression, correlation, coefficient of determination, t-test, and F-test with IBM SPSS Statistics 27. The results show that Social Media Marketing has a positive and significant effect on purchase decisions (t = 8.361; p < 0.001), while Brand Awareness has a positive but insignificant effect (t = 0.925; p = 0.357). Simultaneously, Social Media Marketing and Brand Awareness have a positive and significant effect on purchase decisions (F = 70.849; p < 0.001). The coefficient of determination is R² = 0.579, indicating that 57.9% of the variation in purchase decisions is explained jointly by the two independent variables.

latest.title: From Gratuity to Compensation Interface: The Managerial Transformation of Tipping in the United States, 1880–2026
latest.abstract: This article examines how tipping in the United States evolved from a contested interpersonal gratuity into an organizationally designed component of worker compensation. Using a historical-interpretive approach, the study integrates contemporaneous newspapers, legislation, congressional hearings, judicial decisions, administrative rules, occupational evidence, point-of-sale documentation, transaction data, and employer experiments. The analysis traces five periods from pre-1966 normalization through contemporary expansion and contestation. Tipping evolved from an anticipated supplement to wages into a legally institutionalized, technologically observable, and managerially configurable compensation mechanism. Digital technologies did not originate customer participation in worker compensation; rather, they increased its visibility, measurability, and organizational control. Contemporary “tipflation” therefore reflects the diffusion of tipping across transactions as well as changes in gratuity amounts. The article develops the concept of the compensation interface to explain how organizations allocate, administer, and structure customer participation in worker compensation across changing legal and technological environments. The findings imply that tipping policies, suggested gratuities, and service charges should be treated as compensation-system design choices that allocate responsibility and risk among firms, workers, and customers.
latest.subfield: Organizational Behavior and Human Resource Management

latest.title: Analysis of Consumer Perception of Minimalist Packaging Design as a Marketing Communication Strategy in Digital Business
latest.abstract: The development of digital business is encouraging companies to utilize packaging design as a marketing communication strategy that can attract young consumers through visual displays on digital media. Minimalist packaging design has become a widely used trend because it is considered to create a modern, simple, and professional impression. This study aims to determine consumer perceptions of minimalist packaging design as a marketing communication strategy in digital businesses and analyze the influence of visual communication elements on the appeal of young consumers. The study used a quantitative approach with descriptive methods. Data collection was conducted by distributing questionnaires to 100 young consumer respondents aged 17–30 who actively use digital platforms such as Shopee, TikTok Shop, and Instagram Shopping. Data analysis used IBM SPSS Statistics through validity and reliability tests and descriptive percentage analysis. The results show that minimalist packaging design has a very good perception with an average score of 87%. The study's conclusions confirm that minimalist packaging design is effective as a visual-based marketing communication strategy in the digital business era.

latest.title: The Effect Of Service Quality And Price On Consumer Satisfaction (Case Study Of Consumers At Sukajaya Store, Ciawi Market, Tasikmalaya Regency)
latest.venue: Journal of Law Social Science and Management Review
latest.abstract: This study aims to determine and analyze the influence of service quality and price on customer satisfaction at Toko Sukajaya, Ciawi Market, Tasikmalaya Regency, both simultaneously and partially. The study employs a quantitative approach with a causal research design. The population consists of all Toko Sukajaya customers, while the sample was selected using purposive sampling, resulting in 100 respondents. Data were collected via questionnaires and analyzed using descriptive analysis, validity and reliability tests, the Method of Successive Intervals (MSI), classical assumption tests, multiple linear regression analysis, correlation coefficient analysis, the coefficient of determination, the F-test, and the t-test. The results indicate that service quality and price simultaneously have a positive and significant influence on customer satisfaction. Partially, service quality has a positive and significant influence on customer satisfaction. Similarly, price has a positive and significant influence on customer satisfaction. The coefficient of determination (R²) is 0.620, indicating that 62% of customer satisfaction can be explained by service quality and price, while the remaining 38% is influenced by other variables not examined in this study.

latest.title: Factors Influencing Generation Z to Purchase Viral Culinary Products at the Batang Agam Payakumbuh Street Food Area: FAKTOR YANG MEMENGARUHI GENERASI Z MEMBELI PRODUK KULINER VIRAL DI STREET FOOD BATANG AGAM PAYAKUMBUH
latest.abstract: Abstract. This study aims to determine the influence of viral marketing, FOMO, self reward, and price perception on Generation Z’s purchasing decisions regarding viral street food in Batang Agam, Payakumbuh. This study is expected to provide insights for business owners in designing more effective marketing strategies to enhance business effectiveness and sustainability. This study employs a quantitative approach to support the validity of the results and to understand the cause and- effect relationships among the variables under study. The sample size for this study was 100 respondents. The sampling technique used was non-probability sampling via a purposive sampling approach. The collected data were analyzed using multiple linear regression with the help of SPSS software. This study found that FOMO, self reward, and price perception have a significant and positive influence on Generation Z’s purchasing decisions.Viral marketing does not have a significant influence and exerts a negative impact on Generation Z’s purchasing decisions. Consumers do not immediately purchase a product simply because it has gone viral on social media rather. The findings of this study can serve as a reference for business owners so that they do not focus solely on the virality of their products when trying to attract consumers. Abstrak. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk mengetahui pengaruh viral marketing, FOMO, self reward, dan persepsi harga terhadap keputusan pembelian Generasi Z terkait jajanan kaki lima yang sedang viral di Batang Agam, Payakumbuh. Penelitian ini diharapkan dapat menjadi pedoman bagi para pelaku usaha dalam merancang strategi pemasaran yang lebih efektif guna meningkatkan efektivitas dan keberlanjutan bisnis. Penelitian ini menggunakan pendekatan kuantitatif untuk menduku

latest.title: Pengaruh Kinerja Professional Pelayanan dan Persepsi Nilai Harga terhadap Kepuasan Pelanggan di Gong Jatiluwih Restaurant, Tabanan, Bali
latest.abstract: Penelitian ini dilakukan untuk menganalisis dampak Kinerja Profesional Pelayanan dan Persepsi Nilai Harga terhadap Kepuasan Pelanggan di Gong Jatiluwih Restaurant, Tabanan, Bali, baik secara terpisah (parsial) maupun bersama-sama (simultan). Menggunakan metode kuantitatif, data dikumpulkan melalui kuesioner yang disebarkan kepada 120 pelanggan yang dipilih berdasarkan rumus Hair. Data kemudian diuji melalui analisis regresi linear berganda serta serangkaian uji statistik pendukung. Temuan di lapangan menunjukkan bahwa Kinerja Profesional Pelayanan secara parsial memiliki pengaruh positif dan signifikan terhadap Kepuasan Pelanggan (nilai signifikansi < 0,001). Hal yang sama juga ditemukan pada Persepsi Nilai Harga yang berpengaruh positif dan signifikan terhadap Kepuasan Pelanggan (nilai signifikansi < 0,001). Ketika diuji bersama-sama, kedua variabel tersebut terbukti berpengaruh positif dan signifikan dalam membentuk Kepuasan Pelanggan dengan kontribusi (Adjusted R Square) sebesar 47,5%. Sementara itu, sisanya dipengaruhi oleh faktor-faktor lain yang tidak dibahas dalam penelitian ini. Kesimpulannya, kombinasi pelayanan yang profesional dan harga yang dinilai layak menjadi kunci utama dalam menjaga Kepuasan Pelanggan

latest.title: Towards Sufficiency in Consumer Electronics? Consumers’ Perceptions of Longevity Strategies for Postponing Product Replacement
latest.abstract: The circular economy highlights the need to slow resource use by making products last longer. Although various longevity strategies have been proposed, it remains unclear whether consumers perceive these strategies as effective. This paper draws on literature on lifetime extension strategies and behavioural theories to investigate the extent to which consumers perceive these strategies as effective in postponing replacement. A survey of 617 consumers examined the perceived effectiveness of 13 product lifetime extension strategies across four product categories using ANOVAs. Durability and reliability emerged as the strategies perceived to be most effective. Preventing functional problems during product use is particularly important for postponing product replacement, as such problems appear to be prominent triggers for replacement. However, consumers remain unconvinced about the effectiveness of most other strategies. Correlational analyses revealed that satisfaction with lifetimes is negatively correlated with perceived strategy effectiveness, suggesting that consumers are less likely to search for lifetime-extending strategies as they do not see lifetime as a concern. These findings underscore the need for design/policy interventions to strengthen durability and enhance awareness of lifetime-extending strategies.

latest.title: A Study of CHAGEE's Marketing Strategies
latest.venue: Advances in Economics Management and Political Sciences
latest.abstract: Against the backdrop of the growing popularity of China-chic consumption and increasing saturation and competition in the new-style tea beverage industry, young consumers' growing cultural confidence, health awareness, and desire for social sharing are reshaping the marketing strategies of tea beverage brands. Taking CHAGEE as its subject, this paper examines the factors influencing consumer behavior in the new-style tea beverage market from two perspectives: sociocultural influences and consumer psychology. It explores the underlying connections between CHAGEE's marketing strategies and consumer behavior. The study finds that CHAGEE effectively responds to the preferences of contemporary young consumers through a brand culture rooted in modern Chinese aesthetics, health-oriented product positioning, flexible tiered pricing, and culturally aligned IP collaborations, enabling the brand to rapidly gain widespread recognition. However, the brand also faces potential operational risks, including excessive dependence on a flagship product, a relatively narrow product range, and weak market performance of new products. This paper summarizes its marketing experience and existing problems, providing a reference for other new-style tea beverage brands in China seeking to avoid the pitfalls of viral popularity and achieve sustainable long-term development.

latest.title: Pengaruh Persepsi Harga dan Promosi Cashback terhadap Keputusan Pembelian Mahasiswa Universitas Negeri Medan Pengguna Shopee
latest.venue: Jurnal Ekonomi Bisnis Manajemen dan Akuntansi
latest.abstract: Perkembangan e-commerce telah memberikan kemudahan bagi konsumen dalam melakukan pembelian secara digital. Shopee sebagai salah satu marketplace yang banyak digunakan menawarkan berbagai strategi pemasaran, termasuk penetapan harga dan promosi cashback yang dapat menjadi pertimbangan konsumen dalam mengambil keputusan pembelian. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk menganalisis pengaruh persepsi harga dan promosi cashback terhadap keputusan pembelian pengguna Shopee pada mahasiswa Universitas Negeri Medan. Penelitian ini menggunakan pendekatan kuantitatif dengan 104 responden yang dipilih menggunakan teknik purposive sampling. Data diperoleh melalui penyebaran kuesioner menggunakan Google Form dan dianalisis dengan IBM SPSS Statistics 29 melalui uji validitas, reliabilitas, asumsi klasik, regresi linear berganda, uji t, uji F, dan koefisien determinasi. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa persepsi harga berpengaruh positif dan signifikan terhadap keputusan pembelian dengan nilai t sebesar 9,687 dan signifikansi < 0,001. Sementara itu, promosi cashback tidak berpengaruh signifikan secara parsial terhadap keputusan pembelian dengan nilai t sebesar -0,025 dan signifikansi 0,980. Secara simultan, persepsi harga dan promosi cashback berpengaruh signifikan terhadap keputusan pembelian dengan nilai F sebesar 104,689 dan signifikansi < 0,001. Nilai R Square sebesar 0,675 menunjukkan bahwa kedua variabel independen mampu menjelaskan 67,5% variasi keputusan pembelian. Dengan demikian, persepsi harga menjadi faktor yang berpengaruh terhadap keputusan pembelian, sedangkan promosi cashback tidak menunjukkan pengaruh secara parsial.

latest.title: Housing Price Pressure and Employee Lawsuits: Evidence From China
latest.venue: Journal of International Financial Management and Accounting
latest.abstract: ABSTRACT This study explores how rising housing prices affect employee–employer conflict through the lens of employee lawsuits. Using a sample of Chinese listed firms from 2013 to 2019, we find that the likelihood of employee lawsuits against a firm increases with housing prices in the city where the firm is located. To establish causality, we employ a staggered difference‐in‐differences approach based on the implementation of home purchase restriction policies designed to curb housing price growth, and we also use land supply as an instrument for housing prices. Mechanism and cross‐sectional analyses show that psychological pressure can be the key mechanism driving employee lawsuits. Additional analyses demonstrate that housing price pressure leads to substantiated employee lawsuits instead of vexatious lawsuits. Also, it does not significantly increase other types of litigation, indicating that the psychological pressure primarily affects internal labor relations rather than external stakeholder disputes. These findings indicate that external cost‐of‐living pressures can erode workplace relations and escalate labor conflict. Overall, our paper provides novel evidence on how macroeconomic housing market conditions shape employee–employer dynamics and labor litigation.

latest.title: Pengaruh Harga di E-Commerce dan Store Atmosphere Pasar Modern terhadap Minat Beli Pakaian di Pasar Tradisional Kabupaten Lombok Timur
latest.venue: Jurnal Semesta Ilmu Manajemen dan Ekonomi
latest.abstract: Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk menganalisis pengaruh Harga di E-Commerce dan Store Atmosphere Pasar Modern terhadap Minat Beli Pakaian di Pasar Tradisional Kabupaten Lombok Timur. Penelitian ini menggunakan metode kuantitatif dengan jenis penelitian asosiatif kausal. Sampel penelitian berjumlah 100 responden yang ditentukan melalui teknik purposive sampling dengan kriteria berusia 18 tahun ke atas, pernah melakukan pembelian pakaian di pasar tradisional Kabupaten Lombok Timur, pernah menggunakan e-commerce untuk membeli pakaian, serta pernah berbelanja di pasar modern. Data dikumpulkan menggunakan kuesioner dengan skala Likert dan dianalisis menggunakan regresi linear berganda dengan bantuan SPSS. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa Harga di E-Commerce berpengaruh positif dan signifikan terhadap Minat Beli dengan koefisien regresi sebesar 0,318, nilai t hitung sebesar 4,190 > t tabel sebesar 1,984, dan nilai signifikansi p < 0,05. Variabel Store Atmosphere Pasar Modern juga berpengaruh signifikan terhadap Minat Beli dengan koefisien regresi sebesar 0,367, nilai t hitung sebesar 5,276 > t tabel sebesar 1,984, dan nilai signifikansi p < 0,05. Secara simultan, Harga di E-Commerce dan Store Atmosphere Pasar Modern berpengaruh signifikan terhadap Minat Beli dengan nilai F hitung sebesar 42,378 > F tabel sebesar 3,09 dan nilai signifikansi p < 0,05. Temuan ini menunjukkan bahwa pertimbangan harga pakaian di e-commerce serta suasana dan kondisi lingkungan belanja di pasar modern dapat menjadi faktor yang memengaruhi minat beli pakaian di pasar tradisional Kabupaten Lombok Timur.

latest.title: The Role of Service Quality and Price in Customer Satisfaction at Prima Freshmart Tajur Citeureup Fresh Food Retail
latest.venue: ENDLESS International Journal of Future Studies
latest.abstract: The intense competition among various modern and traditional retail formats places customer satisfaction as a crucial factor for survival, particularly within the fresh food retail industry. This quantitative associative study aims to analyze the partial and simultaneous effects of service quality and price perception on customer satisfaction. Data were gathered via questionnaires using an incidental sampling technique among customers of a fresh food retail outlet and were subsequently analyzed through multiple linear regression after ensuring all classical assumptions were satisfied. The findings reveal that both service quality and price contribute positively and significantly to shaping customer satisfaction, both partially and simultaneously. Between the two variables, price perception exerts a more dominant influence on customer satisfaction. Although overall customer satisfaction is high, the evaluation indicates minor weaknesses in employee responsiveness and price competitiveness. Therefore, management is advised to prioritize enhancing service speed during peak hours and conducting regular price monitoring to strengthen competitiveness and encourage positive word-of-mouth recommendations.
